audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 read Skill while whys[3] says you take 'a free health bar every trade he can't match' and whys[4] says 'he's an immobile tank who can't answer your tempo'; 2+ items read Kled while whys[6] and late both say a two-item Maokai soaks your burst and you do not out-scale him. The packet chart is Skill/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Skill.
audit.why: Three rows rendered a side token contradicted by their own why-line, and the packet agrees with the prose on all three.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 to Kled, 2+ items to Skill, as matched pairs in both layers; ratings 7/10 and 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twisted Advance carried no cooldown anywhere — 'dodge it, engage when it's down' with no idea how long down lasts. Sapling Toss's timer was absent too.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14/13/12/11/10s, Sapling Toss 18/17/16/15/14s, Bramble Smash 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s, Nature's Grasp 130/110/90s. The 14s W is the actual trade clock in this lane.
audit.corrected: The 14s Twisted Advance and 18s Sapling Toss written into the cooldown block, the Do's, the Don'ts and the Levels 4-5 row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) Nothing said Twisted Advance makes him untargetable while dashing — so a Bear Trap thrown at the dash simply whiffs, wasting your only commit tool. (b) Five strings claim Bear Trap deals 'percent-max-HP' damage; Riot's text says only 'additional physical damage' on the shackle, with no percent component in any Kled ability.
audit.why: The untargetable window is the difference between landing your engage and burning it for nothing. And the percent claim tells a reader his Q shreds tank stats through resistances, which is not a thing his kit does.
audit.corrected: Untargetability written into the interactions row and the cooldown block; the percent claim replaced with the real mechanism (the shackle bonus and Violent Tendencies' four on-hit attacks) in whys[2], whys[5], spikes[1].text and wants.you[0].
sources: kit file kled Q and W

audit.why: Executioner's Calling is already core in report[8]. Sap Magic heals him on attack and its cooldown shortens every time he casts or is hit by a spell, so in an extended trade it ticks constantly — Grievous Wounds is genuinely the item that decides the long exchange.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Twisted Advance's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Stack Violent Tendencies procs and remount off his low DPS — his 14s Twisted Advance is the only tool that flips a trade here.

edits.before: CHAAAARGE turns any side wave into a cross-map gank. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Maokai's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: CHAAAARGE answers his root if you get caught, and it roams — he is an immobile tank who cannot match your tempo.

edits.before: Track Maokai's Twisted Advance (Root): His lock-on root. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is untargetable mid-dash — a Bear Trap thrown at it whiffs. Wait for the landing.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance: matchup-defining — His lock-on root. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Maokai Twisted Advance: matchup-defining — 14s at rank 1, untargetable mid-dash. Commit once it lands or misses. - Sapling Toss: 18s, his only ranged poke. - Your Bear Trap: free, 11s at 800 range.

edits.before: His lock-on root. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His lock-on root, 14s at rank 1 — engage the second it is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Sapling Toss is 18s and hits harder in brush — fight in open lane.

edits.before: Full re-E combo (E-W-E) plus your percent-max-HP Q shreds his tank stats before his slow trade pattern matters.
edits.after: Full re-E combo (E-W-E) plus the Bear Trap shackle out-damages his tank stats before his slow trade pattern matters.

edits.before: Your Eclipse/Trinity Sheen proc plus percent-HP Q is your peak and melts even his bought-up resistances.
edits.after: Your Eclipse Sheen proc plus Violent Tendencies' four attacks is your peak; Executioner's blunts his heal.

edits.before: Eclipse/Trinity Sheen proc plus your percent-max-HP Q (Bear Trap) melts his tank stats — your hardest all-in here.
edits.after: Eclipse/Trinity Sheen proc plus Violent Tendencies' four on-hit attacks beat his tank stats — your hardest all-in.

edits.before: Land Q (Bear Trap) and yank yourself in, then E-W-E all-in his tanky stats with percent-HP shred
edits.after: Land Q (Bear Trap) and yank yourself in, then E-W-E all-in with the four W on-hit shots

notes: No mirror existed; this file defines the chart maokai__kled must invert: Skill, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Skill. Removed the fabricated 'percent-max-HP Q' claim from four strings (it also survives in the long 'early' block, which needs a follow-up pass). DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED: the kit's derived flags mark Bramble Smash (Q) as grounding, but Riot's own description says only that it knocks back nearby enemies, deals magic damage and slows — no grounding. Per the flag-versus-description rule I made no grounding claim, and a reader should not be told his Q shuts off Jousting on the strength of a parse flag alone. Someone with game access should confirm before it goes on the page either way.
